description: 🌌 Love space, science and a little adventure? Join us as we turn curiosity into an interplanetary journey! We're exploring ideas, discovering new possibilities and building a game that's out of this world. 🚀
summary:
Caelum is an interactive educational storytelling website that explores human-made equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars during space exploration missions. Through a collection of stories, users learn about the history, purpose, and significance of these objects, the missions associated with them, and their contributions to scientific exploration.

The project presents space-related information through a structured visual storytelling experience, making complex mission details more accessible and engaging. By focusing on the stories behind these objects, Caelum highlights an often-overlooked aspect of space exploration: the equipment and technology that remain on extraterrestrial surfaces long after their missions have ended.

Caelum aims to encourage curiosity about space exploration while helping users understand the lasting impact of human activities beyond Earth.
details:
Caelum is an interactive educational website that explores human-made equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars during space exploration missions. Users can navigate through the website to discover the stories behind these objects, including their purpose, the missions they were associated with, and their significance to space exploration.

The project aims to make information about space missions more accessible and engaging through digital storytelling. Rather than presenting information as a conventional collection of facts, Caelum focuses on individual objects and their stories, encouraging users to understand the history and lasting presence of human-made equipment on other worlds.

The website was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with Visual Studio Code as the development environment. NASA's Image and Video Library was used as a source of visual and educational material. Canva was used to edit selected videos, and a screen recording demonstrating the exploration of a 3D model was incorporated into the website to provide an additional visual perspective.

The creative aspect of Caelum lies in its storytelling approach, combining educational content, multimedia elements, and interactive website navigation. During development, the team considered factual accuracy, educational value, ease of navigation, visual consistency, and accessibility.

Caelum aims to encourage curiosity about space exploration while highlighting an often-overlooked part of humanity's journey beyond Earth: the equipment and technology that remain on extraterrestrial surfaces after their missions.
